# apollovm

**Tag**: vm, dart, java, compiler, translator, web

## 简介

Portable multi-language VM: parse, run and translate Dart, Java, Kotlin, Go, C#, JavaScript, TypeScript, Lua and Python — with on-the-fly Wasm compilation and MCP/LSP servers.

## 官网

- 源码仓库: https://github.com/ApolloVM/apollovm_dart
- 问题追踪: https://github.com/ApolloVM/apollovm_dart/issues
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/apollovm
